name: mcp-authz
description:
MCP Authorization governs which MCP capabilities an authenticated identity may invoke, matching scope and claim rules against the tool, resource, prompt or JSON-RPC method a request targets.

It identifies the capability from the mirrored Mcp-Method and Mcp-Name headers on MCP 2026-07-28, from the gateway's MCP operation resolver on earlier revisions, and by reading the request body itself on a gateway that has no resolver. A capability it cannot identify is not governed; a request body the gateway could not read is rejected.
